notes: Site: headless Shopify behind Next.js/Vercel (per notes/218.md). Access: plain HTTP GET, desktop UA, no WAF, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic User-Agent:* group only). Navigation discovery: parsed the homepage RSC flight payload (self.__next_f.push chunks) for the full mega-menu link set (11 top-level nodes: Hydration, Personalize, Tableware, Kitchen, Tiffin Boxes, Cookware, Appliances, Cleaning Essential, Kidzbee, Porcelain, Glassware, Gifting - none named Bestsellers) and found a dedicated homepage merchandising section titled 'Bestsellers' (productCollectionTitle) with an 'Explore More' link to /collections/bestseller-nw, previewing 4 products (Slow Cold Pressed Juicer, Steelox Mixer Grinder, Gen Alpha Kids Flask, Quench Pro On The Go). Also grepped sitemap.xml (486 URLs) for best/top-sell/popular/favorite and found two handles: bestseller-nw (the current, homepage-linked one) and bestseller (unlinked from any current nav). Also checked site's own site search is not exposed as a distinct page (search is client-side over static catalogue); relied on nav+sitemap per brief guidance that a zero-result/absent search page is not proof of absence - nav+sitemap gave a definitive positive hit here anyway. Opened /collections/bestseller-nw: confirmed real PLP (product grid, filters, price/colour/design facets) representing the site's own 'Bestsellers' concept, not an editorial page and not a single PDP. Counted qty via the RULE-1 method validated in the prior Home-Decor pass for this same site: the collection's SSR-embedded 'initialProducts' GraphQL payload (edges + pageInfo), NOT the 'initialFilters.price.count' field (that field is a variant total, proven inflated on this same site in the prior pass - e.g. 179 distinct products vs 577 variant-count on /collections/all-products). For bestseller-nw, initialProducts.pageInfo.hasNextPage=false, so the 5 distinct gid://shopify/Product IDs in the payload are the complete, exhaustive listing. Investigated the second sitemap handle /collections/bestseller: it renders (200 OK) but its initialProducts payload contains only 1 distinct product (gid 10391116349734, 'Gen Alpha Kids Flask'), that product is NOT a subset/superset match of bestseller-nw's 5 products, it is unlinked from any current homepage/mega-menu navigation, and the same product actually belongs to the New Launch collection instead - all consistent with the prior pass's documented pattern of stale/orphaned sitemap handles on this site (44 of 223 /products/ sitemap URLs were proven stale/404 in that pass). Treated /collections/bestseller as a superseded/orphaned legacy handle and excluded it rather than double-counting; bestseller-nw is the current canonical Bestsellers listing. No non-English content encountered (site renders 100% in English, en lang attribute, INR pricing).

rows.evidence: SSR flight payload key 'initialProducts': pageInfo.hasNextPage=false with 5 distinct gid://shopify/Product/* IDs in edges (exhaustive enumeration, not the inflated initialFilters.price.count facet); page is homepage-linked via productCollectionTitle:'Bestsellers' -> action_link '/collections/bestseller-nw'
